# COR080 `magic-number-in-array-size`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="info" text="opt-in" />

An array is declared with a literal size other than 0 or 1.

## Why

`real :: flux(5)` hard-codes a size that other code must repeat, and the copies drift apart. Name
it once (`integer, parameter :: nvar = 5`) and declare `flux(nvar)`.

## Reported

```fortran
real(R8P) :: q(5, 100)
```

## Preferred

```fortran
real(R8P) :: q(nvar, ncell)
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[COR080] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = COR080` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/fobos/lint).

## Equivalent

Fortitude rule `C031` (see [Lint Rules](/lint-rules/#relation-to-fortitude)).
